findings.claim: The Top (home) crumb is a link whenever a position exists, even when the view at the top is the same as the current one. Example: a target narrower than the position, sf-math (path:Videos/Study/Math) at position Videos/Study, where both views send folder=[Videos/Study/Math].
findings.impact: Choosing Top adds a history entry and scrolls to the top while showing the same shelves. This is small, but it conflicts with the wording of I8 ('every crumb link goes to a strict ancestor of the position whose view differs from the current one').
findings.evidence: frontend/src/components/appshell/FolderPositionRows.tsx:61-75 renders the home crumb as an <a> whenever position !== null, with no sameFolders check of the kind folderPosition.ts:70 applies to folder crumbs. appFolderPosition.test.tsx 'under a target narrower than the position, no segment is a link but Top' asserts this. Spec §1.5 says the home crumb 'is plain when there is no folder already', so the spec text sanctions it.
findings.repro: not_reproduced. By reading: target sf-math, URL folder=Videos/Study. folders = narrowFolders([Videos/Study/Math], Videos/Study) = [Videos/Study/Math], and at the top folders = targetFolders = [Videos/Study/Math], which is identical.

bucket_proposal.reason: Read literally, I8 rules out a crumb link whose view equals the current one, and the root is an ancestor of every position. §1.5 sanctions the behavior, so a person should decide whether I8 covers the home crumb.

findings.proposed_fix: Draw the home crumb plain when narrowFolders(targetFolders, position) equals targetFolders, or state in I8 that the home crumb is excluded.
